id: The ball holds Eternatus. Would you like to take it?
en: The ball holds Eternatus. Would you like to take it?
it: La sfera contiene Eternatus. Vuoi prenderla?

id: \rMagnolia: Eternatus is the source of all Dynamax energy. I wonder what Galar would be like if it had never settled here.
en: \rMagnolia: Eternatus is the source of all Dynamax energy. I wonder what Galar would be like if it had never settled here.
it: \rMagnolia: Eternatus è la fonte di tutta l'energia Dynamax. Chissà come sarebbe Galar se non si fosse mai stabilito qui.

id: Where would you like to go?\ch[1,-1,Kanto,Orange, Johto,Hoenn,Sinnoh,Unova,Kalos,Alola,Cancel]
en: Where would you like to go?\ch[1,-1,Kanto,Orange, Johto,Hoenn,Sinnoh,Unova,Kalos,Alola,Cancel]

id: \rMagnolia: Welcome. You must be \PN, the Alola Champion. Your friend spoke of you when we met during the Darkest Day.
en: \rMagnolia: Welcome. You must be \PN, the Alola Champion. Your friend spoke of you when we met during the Darkest Day.
it: \rMagnolia: Benvenuto. Tu devi essere \PN, il Campione di Alola. Il tuo amico mi ha parlato di te quando ci siamo incontrati durante il Giorno più Buio.

id: \rI have to thank you for putting a stop to that. Eternatus, the controller of Galar particles, threatened the world with its calamity.
en: \rI have to thank you for putting a stop to that.  Eternatus, the controller of Galar particles, threatened the world with its calamity.
it: \rDevo ringraziarti per averlo fermato.  Eternatus, che controlla le particelle di Galar, minacciava il mondo con la sua calamità.

id: \rThankfully, Leon, Sonia and I have spent a large amount of time to get Eternatus used to humans. I now feel it is safe to be around people.
en: \rThankfully, Leon, Sonia and I have spent a large amount of time to get Eternatus used to humans. I now feel it is safe to be around people.
it: \rPer fortuna, Dandel, Sonia e io abbiamo passato molto tempo ad abituare Eternatus agli esseri umani. Ora credo che sia sicuro stare in sua compagnia.

id: \rYou're strong enough to keep it in check should anything go wrong. If you want it, it's yours.
en: \rYou're strong enough to keep it in check should anything go wrong. If you want it, it's yours.
it: \rSei abbastanza forte da tenerlo a bada se qualcosa dovesse andare storto. Se lo vuoi, è tuo.
I tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati completamente.

id: \rSonia: The Darkest Day is something I never want to see again. I'm glad we were able to stop it.
en: \rSonia: The Darkest Day is something I never want to see again. I'm glad we were able to stop it.
it: \rSonia: Il Giorno più Buio è qualcosa che non voglio rivedere mai più. Sono contenta che siamo riusciti a fermarlo.
